name: ThermaSol Vue 3-4 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Blending striking modern architecture with natural sustainably sourced materials, the Vue Sauna Cabin offers an expansive, light filled experience that unites privacy and transparency. The panoramic facade is constructed from mirrored and insulated tempered glass, forming a futuristic outer shell that mirrors its surroundings to blend in with ease. Rigid black-enamel frames along with an integrated rainwater management system provide all the protection necessary for year-round sauna sessions. The cabin interior delivers immersive floor to ceiling views that feels like you never left the outdoors. Tyrol wooden wall panels feature a beautiful textured grain contrasting elegantly against the supportive thermo-aspen benches and backrests. Lay back and use the independent control to customize full-spectrum LEDs that illuminate from recessed locations for your desired sauna ambiance. With the press of a touchpad, use the Xenio CX45 digital control to swiftly create intense heat and restorative steam through the Harvia Virta electric sauna heater. Supported by ThermaSol's 1-year warranty, the Vue outdoor sauna connects sauna seekers with nature as you experience unparalleled warmth and tranquility from your own backyard. Features Pre-engineered cabin crafted from sustainably sourced materials blending beauty and practicality Floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass for immersive views across three separate walls All-season weatherproofed performance with multi-layer wood fiber insulation, a Firestone EPDM roof, and integrated rainwater management Parsol argon insulated tempered glass with UV-protection for enhanced safety, thermal efficiency and privacy Harvia Virta electric sauna heater for powerful, evenly distributed heating performance Harvia Xenio sauna control touchpad to adjust time and temperature with repeat scheduling and WiFi connectivity through the MyHarvia App Full-spectrum recessed LED lighting with independent controls for a personalized ambiance Ideal for gardens, patios, and backyard wellness spaces Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use Dimensions: 78"W (198.1 cm) x 85"D (215.9 cm) x 89"H (226.1 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia Virta 9kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3020 Sauna Stones (3) Temperature Sensor Headrest (2) Wood Platform MyHarvia App Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 3-4 people Exterior (W × D × H): 78″ × 85″ × 89″ Heater: Harvia 9kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Specification Sheet
